release_notes: Build 88 upgrades Match archive with deep matching across folder names, series/title, explicit episode, Short/full format, rendered-video type, project JSON/timeline text, and matching file names/sizes.
Every unlinked Z: folder is classified as Exact, High, Possible, or No match with visible evidence in a new archive-folder grid.
Relink confident Z copies updates only unique one-to-one Exact/High Quiz History paths, including records that still point at an old C:/other backup folder.
Relink selected allows an individual suggested match to be explicitly approved after reviewing its confidence and evidence.
Relinking changes database paths only: existing C: folders remain untouched and no Z: files are copied, moved, renamed, overwritten, or deleted.
Build 87 added the detailed read-only Quiz Archive Audit; Build 86 fixed archive action visibility.
Build 83 changes Full and Marathon quizzes to a 5-second default and adds safe post-upload archiving.
